# Recommended GitHub labels

These labels are repository-owner recommendations. This file does not create or modify remote labels.

| Label              | Description                                         | Suggested colour |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `bug`              | Reproducible incorrect behavior                     | `d73a4a`         |
| `feature`          | Focused product improvement                         | `a2eeef`         |
| `ui-ux`            | Interface or interaction design                     | `7057ff`         |
| `accessibility`    | Keyboard, focus, contrast, or assistive technology  | `0e8a16`         |
| `performance`      | Measured responsiveness or resource-use issue       | `fbca04`         |
| `security`         | Security hardening or privately coordinated fix     | `b60205`         |
| `data-integrity`   | Persistence, recovery, migration, or data-loss risk | `e99695`         |
| `video`            | Local video, embeds, or timestamp notes             | `5319e7`         |
| `canvas`           | tldraw editor, shapes, tools, or connections        | `1d76db`         |
| `good first issue` | Small, explained, low-risk contribution             | `7057ff`         |
| `help wanted`      | Maintainer would welcome contributor help           | `008672`         |
| `documentation`    | Documentation-only change                           | `0075ca`         |
| `dependencies`     | Dependency maintenance                              | `0366d6`         |
| `platform-windows` | Windows-specific behavior                           | `c5def5`         |
| `platform-macos`   | macOS-specific behavior                             | `c5def5`         |
| `platform-linux`   | Linux-specific behavior                             | `c5def5`         |

Security reports must follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Do not use a public `security` issue for an active vulnerability.
